cards.name: Gold Card
cards.notes: 4x at restaurants worldwide (up to $50k/yr) and U.S. supermarkets (up to $25k/yr). 3x on flights booked directly with airlines or on AmexTravel.com. Supermarkets exclude superstores and warehouse clubs.

cards.name: Platinum Card
cards.notes: 5x on flights booked directly with airlines or AmexTravel.com (up to $500k/yr). 5x on prepaid hotels booked through AmexTravel.com only.

cards.name: Green Card
cards.notes: 3x at restaurants worldwide, on travel, and on transit.

cards.name: Blue Cash Preferred
cards.notes: 6% at U.S. supermarkets on up to $6k/yr, then 1%. 6% on select U.S. streaming. 3% at U.S. gas stations and on transit (taxis, rideshare, parking, tolls, trains, buses).

cards.name: Blue Cash Everyday
cards.notes: 3% at U.S. supermarkets, U.S. online retail and U.S. gas stations, each on up to $6k/yr, then 1%.

cards.name: Sapphire Preferred
cards.notes: 5x on travel booked through Chase Travel. 3x on dining, select streaming and online groceries (excluding Target, Walmart and wholesale clubs). 2x on other travel.

cards.name: Sapphire Reserve
cards.notes: 8x on Chase Travel purchases. 4x on flights and hotels booked directly. 3x on dining.

cards.name: Freedom Unlimited
cards.notes: Earns Ultimate Rewards points. They transfer to travel partners only when combined with a Sapphire or Ink Preferred card. 5% on Chase Travel.

cards.name: Freedom Flex
cards.notes: 5% in quarterly rotating categories on up to $1,500 per quarter once activated. 5% on Chase Travel.

cards.name: Prime Visa
cards.notes: 5% at Amazon, Whole Foods and Chase Travel with an eligible Prime membership. 2% at restaurants, gas stations and on local transit and commuting.

cards.name: Double Cash
cards.notes: 2% on everything (1% when you buy, 1% when you pay), earned as ThankYou points. Full transfer partner value needs a Strata Premier.

cards.name: Custom Cash
cards.bonusLabel: Your top spend category each billing cycle
cards.notes: 5% in your top eligible category each billing cycle on up to $500, then 1%. Eligible: dining, groceries, gas, travel, transit, streaming, drugstores, home improvement, fitness clubs, live entertainment.

cards.name: Strata Premier
cards.notes: 10x on hotels, car rentals and attractions booked through Citi Travel. 3x on air travel, other hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, gas and EV charging.

cards.name: Savor
cards.notes: 3% on dining, entertainment, popular streaming and at grocery stores (excluding superstores like Walmart and Target).

cards.name: Venture X
cards.notes: 10x on hotels and rental cars and 5x on flights booked through Capital One Travel. 2x on everything else.

cards.name: Venture
cards.notes: 5x on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel. 2x on everything else.

cards.name: Quicksilver
cards.notes: 1.5% on everything.

cards.name: Discover it Cash Back
cards.notes: 5% in quarterly rotating categories on up to $1,500 per quarter once activated, then 1%.

cards.name: Active Cash
cards.notes: 2% cash rewards on everything.

cards.name: Autograph
cards.notes: 3x on restaurants, travel, gas stations, transit, popular streaming and phone plans.

cards.name: Bilt Mastercard
cards.notes: Earns points on rent with no fee. Points require at least 5 transactions per statement. Bilt's card lineup changed in 2026, so check your current terms.

cards.name: Apple Card
cards.notes: 2% when paying with Apple Pay, 1% with the physical card. 3% at Apple and select merchants with Apple Pay.

cards.name: Customized Cash Rewards
cards.notes: 3% in a category you choose: gas and EV charging, online shopping, dining, travel, drugstores or home improvement. 2% at grocery stores and wholesale clubs. The 3% and 2% share a $2,500 quarterly cap.

cards.name: Delta SkyMiles Gold
cards.notes: 2x on Delta purchases, at restaurants worldwide and at U.S. supermarkets.

cards.name: United Explorer
cards.notes: 2x on United purchases, dining and hotel stays booked directly with the hotel.

cards.name: Bonvoy Boundless
cards.notes: Up to 6x at Marriott hotels. 3x on groceries, gas and dining on the first $6k combined per year.

cards.name: Hilton Honors
cards.notes: 7x at Hilton hotels. 5x at U.S. restaurants, U.S. supermarkets and U.S. gas stations.
